correctness.rationale: For each facet, the orthogonal projection barycentric coordinates yield the simultaneous-activity condition \(\|y\|_1+\|y\|_\infty\le1\). Edge normal cones give the same condition; all vertex normals occur throughout the octahedron interior. The strict locus therefore has \(\(6+12+8=26\)\) distinct bases. The exact rational chamber integral proves the volume fraction \(1/4\).
